sentence: This project covers how mouse models and other experimental models are used to study human cancer, including tumor genetics and the immune system.
This project develops tests to monitor pathogens in axolotls and writes a manual to help labs diagnose common axolotl diseases.
This project studies how methamphetamine craving grows stronger over time by looking at changes in gene expression in the rat nucleus accumbens.
This project builds deep learning software that turns a clinical scan image into a clearer image with much less noise.
This project builds a computer framework that uses data mining to help doctors diagnose rare diseases faster.
This project studies how two lysosomal hydrolases help pancreatic cancer survive and grow, and develops targeted inhibitors of them.
This project tries to find out which proteins in bacterial pathogens are targeted by metabolites from the microbiota, probiotics and diet.
This project uses brain imaging to study how receptors for dopamine and glutamate interact during degenerative disease.
This project studies how genetic background affects liver toxicity from adeno-associated virus vectors used for gene delivery, using mice.
This project develops imaging methods to spot metabolic and redox changes that show whether a lipid drug emulsion works against glioblastoma.
This project tests the safety of a gene editing approach that corrects the genetic cause of alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency in a mouse model.
This project studies how Rho-kinase controls insulin secretion in pancreatic β-cells.
This project offers resources and a community of colleagues to support studies of hematopoiesis and stem cell biology.
This project develops tests using genome-wide methylation and protein assays to detect ovarian cancer early in uterine lavage samples.
This project studies why HIV reservoirs decay at different rates in people on antiviral therapy, using machine learning.
This project uses tumor sequencing to find out how toxic exposure shaped the cancers of rescue workers and residents and how they respond to treatment.
This project builds optical coherence tomography imaging to see structure and blood vessel changes in the optic nerve head in glaucoma.
This project studies how RNA folds inside cells and finds functions for RNA enzymes.
This project compares ways to deliver gene editing reagents into hepatocytes and selects edited cells with acetaminophen to treat familial hypercholesterolemia in a mouse model.
This project studies how a protein in smooth muscle cells controls vascular disease and vascular dementia.
